title: Animals
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. Scope: chickens, cows, deer, dogs, elk, foxes, goats and rabbits, with the Creation Club pets (Sweet Roll, Hilda, Thistle) on their kind's page. All of them are level 1 to 3 in vanilla, except the three follower dogs, which scale with the player. The prey lists that draw elk and deer, and the ambient lists that draw foxes and rabbits, are on *Game & Livestock* and *Fox*. Elk, deer, cows and chickens keep their vanilla level: the mod leaves them out (user, 2026-11-12).

the wild (1) and domestic (3) goats, Gleda, the Pelagius Wing goat, the CC pet Hilda
